integrity: All asserted infinite-dimensional identities are derived analytically. Finite checker tests are diagnostics only, and no independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The exact norm covers nonconstant affine maps with proper internally tangent image disks and only the forward product on Hardy H2; no claim for other linear-fractional maps, endpoints, or other Schatten powers. Earlier Clifford--Zheng full text was unavailable; priority risk remains.
title: Exact Hardy Schatten-two contact-angle profile for tangent affine composition products
